claim: Across two independent 2025-2026 studies, proposed agentic pathology systems report higher accuracy than the compared multimodal/pathology baselines on complex evaluation tasks such as visual question answering and multiple-choice diagnosis.

As of mid-2026, on two independent long-horizon agent benchmarks—SWE-Marathon (software) and Chi-Bench (healthcare)—frontier agents complete under 30% of end-to-end tasks under each benchmark’s primary pass criteria.

Across independent evaluations, LLMs exhibit substantially lower and less human-aligned personalization performance on human or realistic long-horizon data than on synthetic or simplified setups, including cases where humans rate ‘personalized’ outputs no better than generic ones.
